M-MONEY.NAME: Money
M-MONEY.purpose: Parse and format monetary amounts as integer cents without floating-point drift.

fn-parseAmount.PURPOSE: Money exports parseAmount with validated inputs and explicit errors.

fn-formatAmount.PURPOSE: Money exports formatAmount with validated inputs and explicit errors.

type-MONEY_INVALID.PURPOSE: Money validation error raised on invalid input.

contract.purpose: Parse and format monetary amounts as integer cents without floating-point drift.

param.name: input
param.description: Money validates every input before use and reports errors explicitly.

param.name: result
param.description: Money returns deterministic results; failures throw instead of returning sentinel values.

error.description: Raised when Money receives invalid input.

M-MONEY.notes: All demo arithmetic is performed on integer cents so subtotals are exact. Floats are never used for storage; formatting is the only place decimals appear.
